JUDGE BURST J1-scene — Run C-9 M1 style gate. task_id "J1-scene". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Candidates are paintings of the same section of a game level, each painted over the same GEOMETRY GUIDE (flat colours: tan = path, light grey = verge, dark = cliff face, pure green = empty void).
Image 1 = candidate P; Image 2 = candidate Q; Image 3 = candidate R; Image 4 = candidate S; Image 5 = candidate T; Image 6 = the GEOMETRY GUIDE (axis 3); Image 7 = the MANUSCRIPT anchor (axes 1–2: palette, way of painting).
Score each candidate on axes 1–5 (integers 1–5) with ONE-LINE reasons each: 1 PAINTED-BOOK FIDELITY — does the subject, palette and iconography read as a page of a late-medieval illuminated manuscript brought to life (compare the manuscript anchor)? · 2 WATERCOLOR-AND-INK HAND — pen-and-ink contour, hand-drawn hatching, transparent washes laid unevenly (pooling, granulation, blooms), pale paper-like highlights; NOT a digital painting, render or airbrushed gradient · 3 OBEDIENCE — boundaries match the geometry guide (rim line, path edges, cliff face outline and lower cut edge, boulder footprint); green void left flat pure green · 4 GAME READABILITY — the walkable path is the BRIGHTEST and CALMEST region; a small figure would read clearly on it · 5 CAMERA — fixed high three-quarter ORTHOGRAPHIC view as the guide sets it. Judge every candidate independently; do not assume any is a control; do not guess which image generator or register produced any image. Write out/judgment.json: {"task_id":..., "candidates": {"<label>": {"axes": [a1,a2,a3,a4,a5], "reasons": [5 one-line strings], "notes": "<one line>"}}, "ranking": [labels best→worst]}. view_image only. No image generation, no code, no web, no other files. RETURN: receipt task_id; images = []; calls_used = 0; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 7 — the MANUSCRIPT anchor (axes 1–2: palette, way of painting)
